From 9b9322db5c5a1917a66c71fe47c3848a9a31227e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Stefan Wahren <stefan.wahren@i2se.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2018 20:02:59 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] brcmfmac: Fix check for ISO3166 code

The commit "regulatory: add NUL to request alpha2" increases the length of
alpha2 to 3. This causes a regression on brcmfmac, because
brcmf_cfg80211_reg_notifier() expect valid ISO3166 codes in the complete
array. So fix this accordingly.

Fixes: 657308f73e67 ("regulatory: add NUL to request alpha2")
Signed-off-by: Stefan Wahren <stefan.wahren@i2se.com>
Acked-by: Franky Lin <franky.lin@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Kalle Valo <kvalo@codeaurora.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/cfg80211.c b/drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/cfg80211.c
index 15fa00d79fc6..1ad97a40940d 100644
--- a/drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/cfg80211.c
+++ b/drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/cfg80211.c
@@ -6802,7 +6802,7 @@ static void brcmf_cfg80211_reg_notifier(struct wiphy *wiphy,
 		return;
 
 	/* ignore non-ISO3166 country codes */
-	for (i = 0; i < sizeof(req->alpha2); i++)
+	for (i = 0; i < 2; i++)
 		if (req->alpha2[i] < 'A' || req->alpha2[i] > 'Z') {
 			brcmf_err("not an ISO3166 code (0x%02x 0x%02x)\n",
 				  req->alpha2[0], req->alpha2[1]);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211/brcmfmac/cfg80211.c`**
   - The loop that checks for valid ISO3166 country codes has been modified. 
   - The original loop iterated over the entire length of `req->alpha2` (which is now 3 due to the previous commit), but it has been changed to iterate only over the first 2 characters of `req->alpha2`. This ensures that only valid ISO3166 codes (which are 2 characters long) are checked.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `cfg80211.c` is a direct response to a regression caused by a previous commit that increased the length of the `alpha2` array to 3 characters. The change ensures that the `brcmf_cfg80211_reg_notifier()` function correctly validates only the first 2 characters of the `alpha2` array, aligning with the expected format for ISO3166 codes and preventing potential errors in processing country codes. This fix addresses the issue introduced by the commit that added the NUL character to the request for `alpha2`.
